spans.s: Loin,Ⓒs.ⒹSroRi-RI f., kawi-wI f., nitaMbaH, jaGanaM, sPic f. (‘hip & l(oin)s’); SroRiPalakaM, kawI-SroRi-tawaM; ‘gird the l(oin)s’ parikaraM baMD 9 P, kawiM baMD; ‘born from oneʼs own l(oin)s’ aMgaja, aMgajAta.

Loiter,Ⓒv. i.ⒹvilaMb 1 A, maMdAyate (D.), kAlaM kzip 6 P or hf 1 P; ‘l(oiter) about’ maMdaM maMdaM cal-r 1 P, itastataH maMdaM Bram 1, 4 P, ciraM avasTA 1 A.
Ⓝ[Loiter]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkAlakzepakaH, alasaH, vilaMbin m., maMdagatiH, cirakriyaH.
Ⓝ[Loiter]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹvilaMbanaM, maMdagamanaM, kAlakzepaH; See Linger, [Linger]er.
